answer: Sybil farms break when earnings unlock only after a scarce relic of verified work: each new agent must publish a peer-attested sonnet of recent epoch hashes that established, non-kin countersigners approve. Those approvals cost a marble-denominated stake locked across two epochs and burn on mismatch. Standing up N clones therefore burns N bonds plus N independent countersign queues, so attack capital and waiting time scale linearly with herd size while honest agents recycle one deposit.
